data.description:
# Child 1 of MS-0MVQO6N34007DHP8 — node-environment guard for the `@ui` import chain (test-first)

## Goal

A node-environment regression guard that fails loudly if the core `@ui` import
graph reached by this repo's unit suites starts value-importing Phaser again —
the exact defect that made the `34e0ab6d` engine tip unusable. This is the
test-first item of the phase: it lands **before** the re-pin, is green at the
currently held pin, and is what proves the re-pin fixed the defect (parent
AC3).

## Context

- Failing chain at core `34e0ab6d`: `@ui/shakeIllegalMove` →
  `./illegalMoveToastView` → `./Renderer/index` (`import Phaser from 'phaser'`,
  runtime use such as `new Phaser.Geom.Rectangle`) → `phaser/src/device/OS.js`
  touches `window` at module scope under node → `ReferenceError: window is not
  defined` at collection, killing 23 unit suites.
- At the held pin `0409c1eb`, `core/src/ui/shakeIllegalMove.ts` imports only
  `../core-engine/SoundManager` and `./ReducedMotion` — node-safe, which is why
  the same suites were green before the tip advanced.
- `@ui` is aliased to `core/src/ui` by `resolveCoreAliases()` in
  `core/scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts`. Game code imports the
  **subpath** `@ui/shakeIllegalMove` (e.g.
  `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerUtils.ts`), which the per-file
  `vi.mock('@ui')` barrel mocks do **not** cover.
- Parent AC3 forbids curing this with `vi.mock('phaser')` / `vi.mock('@ui/…')`
  added to test files. The 22 existing `vi.mock('phaser')` files mock Phaser for
  *active* Phaser behaviour and must be left alone.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Covers parent AC3 — no per-file mock shim:** the green result does not come from adding mocks; a node-environment guard covers the `@ui` chain (detail in the criteria below).
- [ ] A new guard test in the `unit` project (node environment) value-imports
      `@ui/shakeIllegalMove` with **real** Phaser resolution — no
      `vi.mock('phaser')`, no `vi.mock('@ui…')` — and asserts the module loads
      and exports `shakeIllegalMove` as a function.
- [ ] The guard is **green at the held pin `0409c1eb`**, so it can land before
      the re-pin without introducing a red tree.
- [ ] The guard's header comment names the regression it catches (chain above),
      the `ReferenceError: window is not defined` symptom, and the upstream item
      CG-0MVQQ2M8E003FQMZ — so a future reader does not "fix" a red guard by
      adding a mock.
- [ ] Red-ness proven once and documented: with `./core` at the unfixed tip
      (`34e0ab6d`) and the preflight bypassed for that single deliberate run
      (`ENGINE_CHECKOUT_CHECK=warn`, run through the test skill), the guard
      fails with `window is not defined`. Evidence (command + output) recorded
      as a comment on this item.
- [ ] Zero new Phaser mocks: `grep -rln "vi.mock('phaser'" tests | wc -l` stays
      at 22, and no `vi.mock('@ui…')` is added.
- [ ] `resolve.dedupe: ['phaser', 'tone']` is unchanged and
      `tests/tooling/phaser-single-copy.test.ts` still passes (the guard must
      not weaken the single-copy protection).

**Key Files:**
- `tests/tooling/ui-node-import-guard.test.ts` — new guard (filename may differ, but must live under `tests/tooling/`).
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerUtils.ts` — representative real consumer of the `@ui/shakeIllegalMove` subpath.
- `core/src/ui/shakeIllegalMove.ts` — the core module the guard imports (read-only here; fixed upstream).
- `core/scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts` — `resolveCoreAliases()` `@ui` alias the guard resolves through.
- `./vite.config.ts` — `unit` project (`environment: 'node'`, `include: tests/**/*.test.ts`) the guard runs in; `resolve.dedupe` that must stay.
- `tests/tooling/phaser-single-copy.test.ts` — existing single-copy guard that must stay green.
- `docs/dev/testing.md` — doc note for the guard is owned by the docs child, not this one.

## Dependencies

- None upstream of this item (it is the first, test-first slice).
- Blocks the re-pin child (the re-pin's success criterion is this guard going
  green at the new tip).

## Out of scope

- Editing anything under `core/` — the fix is CG-0MVQQ2M8E003FQMZ (upstream).
- A repo-wide "every `@ui` subpath must be node-safe" audit.
- Removing the 22 existing Phaser mocks.
data.title: Node-env guard: @ui import chain stays Phaser-free
